category_title: Elementary student with Duchenne muscular dystrophy exhibiting task-avoidant and attention-seeking disruptive behaviors
minimal_context: Philip is in his English language classroom and is asked to read his homework.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright class, it is time for our English language lesson. Please take out your notebooks so we can read your homework.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Interrupts the lesson speaking out of turn) I am not reading that!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Philip, it is time to read. Please look at your assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves his seat without permission and moves to another place in the classroom) No!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Steps forward to drive him to his seat) Philip, you need to come back and sit in your chair right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Runs around the classroom while singing) La la la! (Falls on the ground and cries as he attempts to escape from the teacher)
